permission_gates: Keep bug/security and code-quality lenses independent and read-only.

behavioral_proof.positive: Two independent native reviewers receive the same scoped diff and their pinned distinct rubrics; coordinator deduplicates a combined verdict.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: One unavailable reviewer yields a labeled partial result, not a double-review claim.
behavioral_proof.error: Malformed diff or failed reviewer is reported with the missing lens and no workspace mutation.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.

codex_note:
## Codex runtime mapping

Pass the same scoped diff to two independent read-only native reviewers in parallel. Give the bug/security reviewer [its pinned role](references/bug-security-reviewer.md) and the code-quality reviewer [its pinned role](references/code-quality-reviewer.md); their full rubrics are `cursor-thermo-nuclear-review` and `cursor-thermos-thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review`. Follow the selected model/effort under `model-capability-router`. The coordinator verifies and synthesizes; if one lens fails, label the result partial.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Launch both thermo-nuclear review subagents in parallel, then synthesize their findings. Use for thermos, double thermo review, or combined bug/security and code-quality branch audits.
proof: Pinned source and role hashes plus deterministic preview prove packaging. Two independent native reviewers received one real PR #64 diff and returned separate ISSUES findings, which the coordinator deduplicated and synthesized. A second fixture interrupted one reviewer and returned a labeled PARTIAL single-lens result. Automatic selection, other hosts, and malformed-diff behavior remain unobserved; reports/pstack-thermos-swarm-real-20260914.md records the bounded cases.
reason: Bundle both named upstream agent roles and map the parallel double review to native read-only reviewers without collapsing the two lenses.

replacements.after:
